description: List supported chains (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana) and the gas-unit constants used by the paid tools (free). Always returns the full, unfiltered list of all 6 chains (no input/filter params). gasUnits.{transfer|usdc_transfer|swap} are plain integers: the gas units a typical transaction of that type costs on an EVM chain (evm) or in Solana compute units (svm) — multiply by the chain's current fee from get_gas_price to estimate USD cost yourself, or just call get_gas_price/compare_gas_costs which already does this.
name: list_chains
